limitations: Semrush Authority Score and Page AS are third-party signals, not Google ranking metrics.
No current exact Page AS or current active/lost donor verification was available for the four conditional prospects.
No current GSC Links export was available; dated local page-performance snapshots do not replace that collision check.
A positive human response is not a backlink until an exact public href, redirect, rel, context, canonical, and indexability are verified.
Parallel links to one target would make causal attribution donor-ambiguous; measure exact target clusters rather than claiming single-donor causality.
